name: Hotel AlpenSchlössl
beschreibung: The Hotel AlpenSchlössl is situated in an idyllic, quiet panoramic vantage point at Reit 15 above Söll in the renowned Wilder Kaiser holiday region in Tyrol. This elegant four-star hotel blends majestic castle-style charm with genuine Tyrolean warmth, offering spacious rooms and suites adorned with fine timber furnishings, marble bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting open panoramas of the craggy Wilder Kaiser and the Hohe Salve. The expansive wellness sanctuary, complete with a heated outdoor pool, indoor pool, diverse saunas, steam room, and relaxation loungers in the manicured castle garden, delivers supreme relaxation. The dining room serves refined multi-course gourmet dinners featuring regional ingredients. The nearby ski bus whisks visitors to the lifts of the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental in minutes, while summer hiking and cycling routes start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star castle-style hotel in Reit in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser featuring panoramic views, luxury spa, outdoor pool, and fine dining.
